title: Kura Sushi USA Reveals New Kura Reserve Menu Featuring Flame-Kissed Black Cod and Sweet, Savory Saltwater Eel
body_markdown:
# Kura Sushi USA Reveals New Kura Reserve Menu Featuring Flame-Kissed Black Cod and Sweet, Savory Saltwater Eel


The premium culinary series returns to Kura Revolving Sushi Bar restaurants for a limited time with flavors that bring warmth and balance to the season


September 9, 2026


[Kura Sushi USA, Inc.](https://kurasushi.com/) , the nation's largest brand of revolving sushi restaurants, announces the debut of four limited-time menu items that highlight the rich, delicate flavors of flame-seared black cod (sablefish) and authentic Japanese Anago (saltwater eel). This Kura Reserve menu features ingredients at their seasonal peak and will be available at participating Kura Revolving Sushi Bar locations this Friday through Sept. 24, while supplies last.


**Savor Dishes with Refined Expressions of Umami:**


- **Seared Teriyaki Black Cod (Sablefish):** Delight in the delicate, buttery texture of black cod from Alaska. Seared to perfection, each slice is marinated with a teriyaki glaze over Kura specialty rice, topped with green onion.
- **Edo-Style Anago (Saltwater Eel):** Melt-in-your-mouth saltwater eel prepared in the traditional Edo-style. Each tender cut is seared, bathed in our house-made anago sauce, and layered over Kura specialty rice.
- **Seared Miso Jalapeño Black Cod Roll:** Buttery Alaskan black cod seared and wrapped alongside avocado, cucumber, and pickled carrot. Miso mayo and marinated jalapeño top the refreshing roll for a balance of savory and spice.
- **Seared Anago Roll:** Saltwater eel lightly seared and paired with fluffy tamago, crisp cucumber, and bright yuzu pepper in a roll rich in umami flavor, drizzled in eel sauce.


“Black cod and anago are regarded in traditional Japanese dining for their delicate textures and rich flavors,” said Newton Hoang, Vice President of Marketing at Kura Sushi USA, Inc. “The September autumn transition inspired us to toast the fall season with our guests, offering comforting sushi plates that are accessible and exceptionally delicious.”


Complementing this limited-time menu are **Seared Miso Honey Cheesecake** —a classic and creamy slice of New York Cheesecake elevated by a drizzle of sweet miso honey topped with a sprinkling of almond crunch, and Kura Reserve Standard nigiri sushi favorites **Bluefin Tuna Otoro** —tender bluefin tuna belly and **Kumamoto Wagyu*** —marbled Japanese wagyu beef topped with garlic chips.


Kura Reserve is a limited-time culinary experience platform that features seasonally inspired creations and complements Kura Sushi’s always-on menu available for dine-in only.


For more information about the Kura Reserve limited-time menu and to make a reservation at participating Kura Revolving Sushi Bar restaurants, visit[kurasushi.com](https://kurasushi.com/) , and download the[Kura Sushi Rewards app](https://kurasushi.com/rewards) to roll into delicious loyalty perks.


*** Kura Revolving Sushi Bar in Buford, Georgia, Naperville, Illinois, and Sugar Land, Texas will not offer Kumamoto Wagyu.


**About Kura Sushi USA, Inc.**


Kura Sushi USA, Inc. is the nation’s largest brand of revolving sushi restaurants that serves authentic Japanese cuisine and delivers a joyful dining experience with more than 90 locations in 24 states and Washington D.C. Utilizing advanced innovation to enhance service speed and accuracy, guests have a wide variety of more than 100 menu items at their fingertips via conveyor belt service inclusive of sushi, sashimi, tempura, noodles, desserts, and more, made with high-quality ingredients free of artificial colorings, preservatives, seasonings and sweeteners. Kura Sushi USA, Inc. was established in 2008 as a subsidiary of Kura Sushi, Inc., a Japan-based revolving sushi chain with more than 600 restaurants internationally and 45 years of brand history. For more information about Kura Sushi USA, visit[kurasushi.com](https://kurasushi.com/) , follow Kura Sushi USA on[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/kurasushiusa) ,[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/kurasushi_usa/) ,[TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@kurasushiusa) &[X](https://x.com/kurasushi_usa) , and download the[Kura Sushi Rewards app](https://kurasushi.com/rewards) to make a reservation and roll into delicious loyalty perks.
